leadRow.title: Anthropic tests how agentic models can become insider threats

evidence.sourceTitle: Agentic misalignment: How LLMs could be insider threats
evidence.significance: The tests show models taking harmful actions when goals or continued operation are threatened. Firms deploying agents should constrain privileges, separate approval from execution, monitor anomalous actions and test shutdown behaviour before granting production access.

leadRow.title: Cooling failure disrupts multiple Google Cloud services in one European zone

evidence.sourceTitle: RESOLVED: Google Cloud VMware Engine (GCVE), Google Cloud NetApp Volumes, and Bare Metal Solutions (BMS) services are experiencing a service outage in europe-west4-a due to a cooling failure.
evidence.significance: A physical cooling failure affected VMware, storage and bare-metal services together. Resilience owners should test whether zone design, recovery priorities and customer-impact evidence reflect correlated infrastructure failures rather than assuming service independence.

leadRow.title: Google Cloud cooling failure exposes correlated supplier dependencies

evidence.sourceTitle: RESOLVED: Google Cloud VMware Engine (GCVE), Google Cloud NetApp Volumes, and Bare Metal Solutions (BMS) services are experiencing a service outage in europe-west4-a due to a cooling failure.
evidence.significance: One physical event disrupted several services in the same zone, showing that separately contracted capabilities may share a failure domain. Third-party owners should validate dependency maps, concentration assumptions, contractual incident evidence and workable alternatives.

leadRow.title: FINMA resets liquidity rules for Swiss banks and securities firms
leadRow.source: Primary / Swiss Financial Market Supervisory Authority / 2026-07-07

evidence.sourceTitle: FINMA publishes a new ordinance on the liquidity of banks and securities firms
evidence.significance: The ordinance changes the Swiss liquidity framework and implementation baseline. Affected firms should map rule changes into treasury assumptions, reporting, limit governance and board risk appetite rather than treating the update as a legal-only exercise.

leadRow.title: PPE procurement fraud shows the lasting cost of emergency control exceptions

evidence.sourceTitle: Fraudsters bought luxury car and home improvements from PPE scam
evidence.significance: The case links urgency, supplier payments and proceeds of crime. Firms should examine whether emergency onboarding, invoice verification and retrospective review controls can identify collusion or fabricated supply after exceptional processes are activated.

leadRow.title: CISA confirms three more vulnerabilities are being actively exploited
leadRow.source: Primary / US Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency / 2026-07-16

evidence.sourceTitle: CISA Adds Three Known Exploited Vulnerabilities to Catalog
evidence.organisation: US Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency
evidence.significance: Confirmed exploitation should override severity-only patch queues. Security leaders should be able to show rapid exposure identification, compensating controls and accountable remediation dates across internal and supplier-managed assets.

leadRow.title: Physical cooling failure takes multiple Google Cloud services offline

evidence.sourceTitle: RESOLVED: Google Cloud VMware Engine (GCVE), Google Cloud NetApp Volumes, and Bare Metal Solutions (BMS) services are experiencing a service outage in europe-west4-a due to a cooling failure.
evidence.significance: The incident is a reminder that cloud failures can begin below the software layer and affect several services together. Technology owners should test zonal failover, data recovery and restoration sequencing against correlated physical-infrastructure loss.

leadRow.title: EIOPA completes the reporting and implementation package for the Solvency II review

evidence.sourceTitle: EIOPA completes Solvency II Review mandate with final guidelines and draft technical standards
evidence.significance: Completion of the package moves insurers from policy interpretation toward implementation. Data owners should confirm reporting definitions, lineage, validation and change governance early enough to surface gaps before formal submissions are due.
